audit_method: Decimal cash-flow plus inventory-value identity, independent of original phase formulas; source hashes and saved entry-year cohort aggregation also verified.
script_inspection: review.py only reads saved account and diagnosis evidence; no replay, model fit, new future-return labels or data requests. Not rerun in audit.
limitations: Accounting contributions identify when actual NAV changed, not why economically or what a different signal would earn.
Entry phase is actual buy fill to same-day close; hold includes previous close through current close; exit is previous close to actual sell fill, not total closed-trade PnL.
Annual opening NAV denominators make phase contributions additive within each year; contribution percentages are not standalone strategy returns.
Cross-year holding is carried continuously without reset. Entry-year trade cohorts are different units and must not be substituted for calendar-year returns.
Fee addback keeps actual capital and position paths unchanged and is not zero-fee simulation. Contract remains 0.1 percent per side.
No causal attribution, signal efficacy, out-of-sample validation or replay correctness audit is implied.
